### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/b21a0e215207df98c7761e8e27d9f4b4af553c72/docs/active/product/source-configs/README.md#L12-L14 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Expand the CRM URL before submitting the config** On a fresh deployment where an operator follows this instruction with `TWENTY_URL` set, CRM onboarding still fails because `timaeus_ctl.source._load_config_document` only runs `yaml.safe_load` and sends the strings unchanged, while Organon's config loader performs no environment substitution; `OpenApiAdapter` consequently attempts to fetch the literal relative URL `${TWENTY_URL}/open-api/core`. Fresh evidence after the earlier bundle finding is that the replacement path removed the old `_substitute_twenty_url` helper but now explicitly directs operators to this non-expanding command, so the new canonical CRM bundle is not registerable as documented. --- https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/b21a0e215207df98c7761e8e27d9f4b4af553c72/docs/active/product/source-configs/README.md#L15-L16 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Transfer the Postmark spec with the source config** On a fresh deployment, `timaeus-ctl source add` transmits only the parsed YAML mapping, not sibling files, so the relative `specs/postmark.openapi.json` never “travels together” to Organon's container or source volume; the image also does not copy `docs/active/product/source-configs`. `SourceOnboarder` passes that client-relative path directly to `OpenApiAdapter`, whose `spec_path.read_text()` therefore fails. Fresh evidence after the earlier bundle finding is that the files now exist in the repository, but the newly documented registration path has no bundle-upload or staging step. --- https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/b21a0e215207df98c7761e8e27d9f4b4af553c72/demo/sokrates_crm/specs/twenty.schema.graphql#L1 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Relocate the Twenty SDL before deleting it** Deleting this SDL silently disables `organon/tests/test_graphql_request_contract.py::test_real_twenty_create_company_resolves_to_company_create_input`, because `_TWENTY_SDL` still points here and the `skipif` converts the missing fixture into a passing skip. Fresh evidence after the earlier fixture finding is that the updated suite now reports this exact production-contract regression test as skipped while the other relocated connector tests pass; move the SDL and update `_TWENTY_SDL` so Twenty's nested create-input and JSON-scalar behavior remains gated. --- https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/b21a0e215207df98c7761e8e27d9f4b4af553c72/demo/ingest_meridian_twenty.py#L1 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Retire the active Meridian runbooks with the deleted driver** After this driver and the corresponding Justfile recipes are deleted, `docs/active/operations/meridian-cross-host-ingest.md` still instructs operators to run `just meridian-ingest-twenty`, this Python file, and the retired Eidos `POST /api/v1/sources` path; `meridian-egress-matrix.md` likewise points to the deleted compose and source files. Following these active operational documents now produces an unknown recipe or missing-file error, so archive or rewrite them and remove the architecture test that still treats the retired matrix as live policy. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L29-L31](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/b21a0e215207df98c7761e8e27d9f4b4af553c72/AGENTS.md#L29-L31) --- https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/b21a0e215207df98c7761e8e27d9f4b4af553c72/organon/tests/test_projection_totality.py#L49-L51 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Update the canonical inventory for the relocated fixtures** After relocating these fixture specs and removing `demo`, update `docs/active/architecture/current-inventory.md`: its INV-46 entries still describe `demo` as an excluded fixture tree, and its INV-53 row still says this test reads `demo/business_distributed/...` and `demo/postmark/...`. Because that document is the repository's authority for implementation status, the commit otherwise leaves a provably false account of both coverage and fixture custody for subsequent architecture work. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L59-L59](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/b21a0e215207df98c7761e8e27d9f4b4af553c72/AGENTS.md#L59-L59)
ℹ️ About Codex in GitHub
[Your team has set up Codex to review pull requests in this repo](https://chatgpt.com/codex/cloud/settings/general). Reviews are triggered when you - Open a pull request for review - Mark a draft as ready - Comment "@codex review". If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍. Codex can also answer questions or update the PR. Try commenting "@codex address that feedback".
